description:
NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR 3.1 for Transport Fever 3 on Windows, with optional DLSS 5 and an in-game menu. Replaces the game's built-in FSR 1 upscaler for a sharper, steadier image.

WINDOWS ONLY. THIS MOD CONTAINS A NATIVE ADD-ON THAT YOU INSTALL BY HAND.
Enabling the mod in the mod list only adds the menu (a D5 button at the top left). The upscaler itself is a Windows add-on (DLLs) that mods cannot install: copy it once next to TransportFever3.exe.

Install (once)
1. Enable the mod, load a game, click the D5 button, then "Install add-on": the add-on's folder opens (it is the "Windows add-on" folder inside this mod's folder).
2. Copy everything in it (Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C).
3. In Steam: right-click Transport Fever 3 > Manage > Browse local files. Paste (Ctrl+V) next to TransportFever3.exe.
4. Restart the game and pick a Resolution scale in the graphics options (67% Quality, 50% Performance, 100% native anti-aliasing).
Nothing in the game's own files is replaced. Uninstall: delete version.dll and the TF3-DLSS folder from the game folder.

What the add-on is
- version.dll: a small stand-in for the Windows file of the same name. The game loads it from its folder; it enables the add-on's Vulkan layer for this game only and passes everything else on to Windows' own version.dll. Nothing is written to the registry or outside the game folder.
- TF3-DLSS\bin: the Vulkan layer, NVIDIA's DLSS runtime and AMD's FSR 3.1 runtime (both unmodified, redistributed under their SDK licenses).
- Full source code and the automated builds these files come from: https://github.com/shimataa/TF3-DLSS5

Menu (D5 button): Upscaler ON/OFF, DLSS 5 ON/OFF, sharpness, info box. Each change is written to the game log; the add-on reads it and applies it within a second. Your saves are not changed.

Requirements: Windows 10/11, Vulkan renderer (default). DLSS: NVIDIA RTX card. FSR 3.1: any GPU. The add-on picks the right one.

DLSS 5 (optional): not included. It needs OptiScaler_DLSSNR and NVIDIA's official DLSS 5 model file, added by you; see TF3-DLSS\dlss5\README.txt. Only NVIDIA's official, unmodified model is supported (for now RTX 50 cards only).

Problems: attach TF3-DLSS\tf3_dlss.log (from the game folder) and the [tf3_dlss5] lines of stdout.txt (Steam\userdata\<your id>\3493540\local\crash_dump), with your GPU.

Unofficial; not affiliated with Urban Games, NVIDIA, AMD or the OptiScaler project. Based on TF3-DLSS by Lucas (MIT). NVIDIA, RTX and DLSS are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation; AMD and FSR are trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
name: TF3-DLSS5 (Windows: DLSS / FSR 3.1)
summary: Windows only. DLSS / FSR 3.1 upscaling (optional DLSS 5) with an in-game menu. Includes a native add-on you copy once into the game folder: read the description.
